topic: What happens to your WhatsApp enquiries when you're busy serving the customer standing right in front of you?

hooks.text: Walk-ins get served. WhatsApp messages wait.
Myth: Automation silences your brand. Fact: Smart bots keep the human touch.
Try this: auto‑reply FAQs so you stay present with every customer.

replies.if_they_say: How much does the chatbot cost?
replies.reply: Hi, thanks for messaging. I build AI chatbots that answer customer questions and take WhatsApp enquiries automatically. What do you want customers to do—call, WhatsApp, book, or fill a form? Pricing is INR 2,999 or INR 4,999 plus INR 299/month maintenance, and you pay only after you approve the work. I can explain how it would work and give a fixed-price scope. Prefer a 5-minute WhatsApp chat or details here?

replies.if_they_say: Do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out. I help small businesses handle WhatsApp messages during busy hours so no enquiry is missed. What type of business do you run, and what questions do customers ask most often?

Of course. I can send a one-page summary: what's included, timeline, and price range. Is the hesitation budget, timing, or whether it will actually bring enquiries? You pay only after you approve the work, so there's no big upfront commitment.

Slide 6 of 6: DM BOT. Message me for honest advice on whether this fits your business. You approve before any money moves.
